critique.recommendation: Run a store-wide search of Banking & Finance matters by file name and by content (EBITDA, add-back, sponsor, portfolio company) to fix the full set of signed facilities. Exclude drafts and treat amendments as the same deal. Then read the ownership or closing documents for each borrower to settle sponsor or corporate control, and extract the add-back clauses per executed agreement.
